# Learn with Anil PYQs (learnwithanil.in)

> Previous year question papers (PYQs) of Indian government recruitment exams with answers from the official final keys, a short explanation for every question, and online practice: question-by-question practice with a timer, timed tests, subject-wise (sectional) tests and topic-wise quizzes. Made by Jupudi Anil Kumar, a civil-services educator in Hyderabad.

Key facts:
- 5,050 questions from the official papers of 8 exams: APPSC Group-II, APPSC Group-I, UPSC CAPF (AC), UPSC EPFO (APFC, EO/AO, PA), SSC CGL, TS Police SI, TS Police Constable, TGPSC HMWSSB Manager (Engineering).
- Answers come only from the official keys published by the recruiting body (APPSC, TSLPRB/TGPRB, UPSC, TSPSC/TGPSC). For a few old APPSC papers (Group 1 2019 and 2023, Group 2 2019) APPSC printed only the correct answer; there the other three options are written by Learn with Anil and labelled.
- Languages: English with Telugu for APPSC, TS Police and TGPSC exams; English with Hindi for UPSC exams.
- Free: every question and its correct answer from the official key are public on the paper, subject and question pages, with the explanations of the first 10 questions of each paper, and a daily question of the day.
- PYQ Pass: ₹45 once for 12 months, covering every previous paper of every exam on the site (and exams added later): every explanation, practice in the app, timed tests, sectionals and study tools.
- UPSC EPFO Mock Test Series: ₹199 for 10 mock tests, coming soon. https://learnwithanil.in/upsc-epfo/mock-test.html
- Mission CGL – SSC CGL Mock Test Series (Tier-I & Tier-II): ₹149 for 13 full-length mock tests (Tier-I Mock 1 and Tier-II Mock 1 are available now; the other 11 mocks are coming soon, all included in the price). https://learnwithanil.in/ssc-cgl/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – TS Police SI Prelims 2026 Test Series: ₹150 for 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 is available now; Mocks 2–10 are coming soon, all included in the price). https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-si/mock-test.html
- Mission Khaki – Constable: TS Police Constable Prelims Test Series: ₹99 for 10 full-length mock tests (Mock 1 (free) is available now; the other 9 mocks are coming soon, all included in the price). https://learnwithanil.in/ts-police-constable/mock-test.html
- Bahubali Test Series (APPSC Group 2 Mains): ₹250 for 24 full-length tests. https://learnwithanil.in/appsc-group-2/bahubali-test-series/
- Not affiliated with APPSC, TSLPRB, UPSC, TGPSC or any recruiting body.
